user.title: Select a source
user.description: Choose a weather station or road camera. Additional sources can be added to the same integration.

weather_station.title: Select a weather station
weather_station.description: Choose a county and submit, then choose a municipality and submit. Select a source from the filtered list, or choose All Norway. Administrative geography: [© Kartverket]({kartverket_url}). Road data: Statens vegvesen.

data_description.station_id: Leave this empty when changing the county or municipality.

camera.title: Select a road camera
camera.description: Choose a county and submit, then choose a municipality and submit. Select a source from the filtered list, or choose All Norway. Administrative geography: [© Kartverket]({kartverket_url}). Road data: Statens vegvesen.

data_description.camera_id: Leave this empty when changing the county or municipality.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to retrieve a complete source snapshot. Try again.
error.station_missing: This station is no longer present in the source response. Select another station or try again.
error.no_stations: The source returned no stations. Try again later.
error.no_cameras: The source returned no cameras. Try again later.
error.camera_missing: This camera is no longer present in the source response. Select another camera or try again.
error.geography_unavailable: County/municipality lookup failed. Try again or choose All Norway and submit.
error.no_sources_in_area: No sources with recognized coordinates were found in this area. Choose another municipality or All Norway.
error.select_source: Select a source from the list.
